headline: Albemarle and SQM Shares Hit 6-Month Lows on Weak Lithium Prices
summary: Lithium miners Albemarle and SQM closed at six-month lows as weaker lithium prices reduced earnings.
why: Lithium producers are heavily exposed to volatile commodity price cycles that directly dictate top-line revenue and profitability for battery-grade materials.

entities.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile

impacts.name: Albemarle Corporation
impacts.why: Albemarle shares hit a six-month low due to falling lithium prices.

impacts.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile
impacts.why: SQM shares also hit a six-month low alongside Albemarle amid weak lithium prices.
